notes:
- **The Notes list is easy to browse past a few days.** Day and week headers are now clear and stay at the top while their notes scroll under them, each with how many notes it holds and how long they run (**TUESDAY, OCT 13 · 7 notes · 2 h 03 m**). This week is listed day by day; older notes sit under weeks that start folded (**LAST WEEK · Oct 5 – 11**). Click a header to fold or open it, use **Fold all** / **Open all**, and what you folded is remembered. A search or filter opens everything.
- **Everything one person said, across every meeting, with no AI.** Open **Everything Nick said** from the Ask page's person filter, a speaker's **⋯** menu on a note, or by typing a name in Ctrl+K. It lists every line they said, newest meeting first, for a range you pick (30 days by default) and optionally containing some words, with a totals line built on your PC ("Nick spoke in 23 meetings (Sep 2 – Oct 15): 1,412 lines, about 3 h 10 m.") that also lists the meetings where their speaker isn't named yet. Copy it, or save it as .md or .csv. **Ask about what Nick said** is the only step that uses a model, and sends only those lines, when you press it. See [Asking your notes](/docs/asking-your-notes/#everything-someone-said).
- **Jump to a date.** The calendar button beside the search box shows a month with a dot and a count on the days that have notes; pick one, or move with the arrow keys and press Enter, and its week opens with that day at the top. See [The note page](/docs/note-page/#days-weeks-and-jumping-to-a-date).
